entries.name: 52-Week High Anchoring Momentum
entries.github_role: related factor framework; not verified exact replication
entries.empirical: Original paper: proximity to 52-week high improves return forecasting beyond past individual and industry returns; no independently checked net Sharpe or max DD
entries.entry: Month-end rank H52 high; research long top quintile and short bottom quintile; long-only filter first
entries.exit: Next monthly rebalance or risk limit
entries.frequency: US equities daily OHLCV, monthly portfolio
entries.params: 252 trading days, 20/80 percentile, industry/size neutral, 2% per name
entries.risk: momentum crashes, gap risk, corporate-action adjustment
entries.cost: monthly turnover, spreads, small-cap impact; exclude stale prices and delisted-survivor bias
entries.data: PIT daily adjusted OHLC and corporate actions
entries.deploy: OHLC PIT -> 252d high -> monthly rank -> controls -> walk-forward costed backtest

entries.name: Amihud Expected Illiquidity Premium
entries.github_role: general factor research; exact factor mapping not verified
entries.empirical: Paper establishes positive expected return-illiquidity relationship; no verified tradeable net Sharpe/DD
entries.entry: Monthly cross-sectional liquidity-cost ranking; investigate high expected illiquidity premium after excluding untradeable names
entries.exit: Monthly rebalancing and liquidity exit guard
entries.frequency: Daily returns and dollar volume; monthly signal
entries.params: 63d rolling, min $5m ADV, max 1% ADV participation, sector-neutral
entries.risk: illiquidity premium may be unharvestable net of impact; crisis exit risk
entries.cost: high spreads/market impact, stale quotes, survivorship, small-stock bias
entries.data: PIT daily return, volume, dollar prices, delisting
entries.stack: Python NumPy, PostgreSQL, Z-QCC liquidity cost
entries.deploy: daily volume -> Amihud ILLIQ -> liquidity universe -> capacity stress -> costed backtest

entries.name: Capital Gains Overhang Disposition Momentum
entries.github_role: generic backtesting engine, not paper replication
entries.empirical: Grinblatt-Han: aggregate unrealized capital gains predict returns; no verified net Sharpe/DD for this simplified estimator
entries.entry: Monthly rank estimated CGO; long high-overhang and research short low-overhang
entries.exit: Monthly rebalancing, turnover and factor-neutral limits
entries.frequency: US stocks daily price/turnover, monthly portfolio
entries.params: 1y turnover-based reference price proxy; 2% single name, sector neutral
entries.risk: true investor cost basis unobservable; turnover proxy can bias results
entries.cost: bid-ask, borrow, price/turnover survivorship; corporate action adjustments
entries.data: PIT OHLC, turnover, free float, optional actual holder cost data
entries.deploy: PIT turnover -> reference price proxy -> CGO -> validation against full estimator -> backtest

entries.name: Dividend Initiation and Omission Drift
entries.github_role: generic event backtest framework, not exact replication
entries.empirical: Original NBER paper: post-event 12m market-adjusted +7.5% initiation, -11.0% omission; long-short positive 22 of 25 sample years; historical gross research figures, not live net performance
entries.formula: Event_i,t=+1 if previous regular cash dividend=0 and new>0; -1 if previous>0 and new=0
entries.entry: Enter after actual public announcement, long initiations; omissions for short research/risk exclusion
entries.exit: 1-12m event study, re-evaluate at next payout and fundamental deterioration
entries.frequency: SEC corporate announcements event-time, daily prices, monthly holding
entries.params: exclude special dividends, confirm omission vs delayed payment, 1% per issuer
entries.risk: dividend omissions coincide with financial distress, earnings and macro shocks
entries.cost: announcement gaps, short borrow, event classification bias, benchmark and delisting effects
entries.data: SEC 8-K, corporate action dividends, timestamped disclosures, PIT prices
entries.stack: SEC parser, Python pandas, PostgreSQL, Z-QCC event engine
entries.deploy: SEC event -> classify initiation/omission -> event-time cohorts -> risk-neutral backtest

entries.name: Stock Split Announcement Underreaction
entries.github_role: generic event backtest framework; no paper reproduction verified
entries.empirical: Ikenberry et al. 1996: 1,275 two-for-one splits, +7.93% abnormal year-one and +12.15% first three years; contradicted by Byun-Rozeff 2003 broader sample, DOI 10.1111/1540-6261.00558
entries.entry: Enter after split announcement only with liquidity/fundamental controls; research long split announcers
entries.exit: 1/3/12m event-time horizon, cap risk and factor exposure
entries.params: two-for-one baseline, min $10m ADV, industry/size matching
entries.risk: old evidence not robust across broad sample, splits do not mechanically create value
entries.cost: corporate-action adjustment, announcement gap, selection and look-ahead bias
entries.data: SEC split announcements, split ratios, PIT OHLC, corporate actions
entries.stack: SEC parser, Python NumPy, PostgreSQL, Z-QCC event study
entries.deploy: SEC split notice -> ratio validation -> adjusted OHLC -> matched controls -> out-of-sample event study
